PW27 Card Explorer

All cards are searchable. Default order is OPness = the largest of ATK−OVR, BAL−OVR or DEF−OVR. Use the edge filter when you only want true overperformers.
Aliases are normalized at search time only — canonical DB names are never rewritten. Examples: South Korea → Korea Republic, Manchester United → Man Utd, Tottenham → Spurs, PSG → Paris SG.
